KataGo.import: Complete git archive of the fixed commit, without repository metadata or local build artifacts

EtaZero_placement_rules.adaptation: Renju continuation analysis and Hex connectivity adapted to source Board, Rules and BoardHistory; no runtime dependency on V3.4

Mctx.adaptation: Completed-Q, improved policy, deterministic interior rule, and sequential-halving visit schedule; C++ adaptation in cpp/search/gumbel.cpp. Includes EtaZero parallel root reservations. Adapted via EtaZero_V3.4 cpp/search/gumbel.cpp; no runtime dependency on that version. Interior selection is connected as an optional alternative to source PUCT; Q uses completed visits and allocation deficits include in-flight work.

MiniZero.adaptation: Masked latent min/max with small-span guard, adapted via EtaZero_V3.4 python/etazero/models/muzero/network.py. Runtime implementations are python/katago/train/muzero_model.py and cpp/neuralnet/muzerohelpers.cu.

EtaZero_MuZero.adaptation: Latent mask/action encoding, normalization kernels and unroll gradient boundaries. V4 reuses its own source Model, Metrics and CUDA learned layers directly; no runtime dependency on V3.4.

Pikafish.scope: Position, legal move generation and full-history adjudication only; no alpha-beta search or evaluation network
Pikafish.adaptation: Vendored from EtaZero_V3.4 cpp/external/pikafish, including its state-copy/rebinding API, adjudication reasons and removal of alpha-beta prefetch hooks. The V4 wrapper owns all history; no runtime dependency on V3.4.

KataGomo_opening.adaptation: No-VC random skeleton and candidate rejection sampling in cpp/program/balancedopening.cpp. Native BoardHistory rules, four-result W-L, shared ordinary/MuZero initial inference and cancellation. Strict positive cumulative sampling removes the source negative epsilon that could select a zero-weight point. Opt-in balanceOpeningProb defaults to zero; source policy initialization remains unchanged.

KataGomo_Hex_opening.adaptation: White-model first-move rejection sampling only, preserving white win probability rather than W-L or expected score. Source fairness/exponent/minimum acceptance defaults apply when enabled. No special templates or random fill. Uses the same native module and evaluator boundary as Gomoku; match games retain independent source GameRunner initialization.
